Independent Codex review update by the non-author review subagent (/root/ops038_review). I did not write the implementation, tests, or workflow edit. This conversation comment is an attributable independent review, not a separate-account formal GitHub approval.

Verdict: APPROVE exact head 091f529e723b0510bee15aaac287c3c716bc4af1 against integration base 01bc90b0ad3fc28a73aa8121eb30f28f19eadfca. No P1/P2 findings.

Pat-authorized scope exception: the only change after reviewed94ae4a2 is the existing game-smoke job timeout in .github/workflows/gauntlet-pr-checks.yml, from60 to90 minutes. Per-suite caps, assertions, suite selection, toolchain pins and job permissions are unchanged. This grants runtime capacity; it does not relax test success requirements.

I fetched and detached the separate038-review checkout at091f529 and independently confirmed identical game/src and game/tests trees against94ae4a2:
- game/src:06af9c248096064ba50bb98efa2de7db1555a44e
- game/tests:b819968809b132264eba407f9cc1c78edce81ea9
- git diff --quiet across both trees returned0. Complete source-identity evidence is in ../042-review-evidence/final091-source-proof.log. The existing finale semantics, optional-state migration, unchanged legacy endings and reused Plate renderer therefore remain as reviewed in the preceding exact94ae review.

Fresh independent checks executed on091f529, Windows Godot4.6.3:
| Check | Result | Exit | Raw log under ../042-review-evidence/ |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| Import | clean | 0 | final091-import.log |
| Core | CHECKS836 FAILURES0 | 0 | final091-core.log |
| finale_provisional_tests / FINALE | 28/0 | 0 | final091-unit.log |
| finale_provisional_ui_tests headless / FINALE UI | 246/0 | 0 | final091-ui.log |
| finale_provisional_ui_tests native Compatibility | 255/0, including9 PNG checks | 0 | final091-native-ui.log |
| Guidance detector unit tests | 10 tests, OK | 0 | final091-guidance-unit.log |
| Guidance audit | structural PASS | 0 | final091-guidance-audit.log |
| Suite registry |258 suites,0 errors,0 warnings | 0 | final091-registry.log |

Commands used powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/toolchain/win/headless.ps1 with -Action Import, -Action Core, or -Action Script -Script finale_provisional_tests/finale_provisional_ui_tests and their registered FINALE/FINALE UI prefixes. Each run used -Isolate, its own absolute final091-CHECK-userdata root, and the listed log. Native UI used common.ps1 Invoke-GodotLogged with --path GAME_DIR --rendering-method gl_compatibility --script res://tests/finale_provisional_ui_tests.gd, a separate absolute isolated root, and SIRENS_042_CAPTURE_DIR set to the absolute final091-captures folder. Its strict Test-GodotLog returned Problems:[]. The9 PNGs remain in ../042-review-evidence/final091-captures.

Python commands were:
- python scripts/toolchain/test-check-gauntlet-guidance.py
- python scripts/toolchain/check-gauntlet-guidance.py --root .
- python scripts/toolchain/check-suites.py

git diff --check passed. Final HEAD was reverified and tracked source/tests/scripts/workflow files have no manual working-tree edits; generated local import metadata is the only checkout churn.

Historical evidence remains labeled94ae4a2, not fresh091: PHOTO ENDINGS92/0, native wall UI42/0, FIX2 SAVE12/0, SAVE PROFILES68/0 plus3 cold-load checks, native profile UI168/0, and BACK EXIT17/0. Those unchanged regressions were not unnecessarily repeated locally.

The former hosted run40166837512 was cancelled at the60-minute limit and is not green. This approval does not claim the new90-minute hosted run passed; the required hosted gates still govern merge. Native tests use controlled fixtures and injected touch/Android Back, not a full campaign or physical-phone playthrough. No full local matrix, phone/APK, new photo viewer, or tap/enlarge interaction is claimed.
